rules.name: supermarket lamps
rules.note: User playtest 2026-11-21 (8-3 pose 148, 10B's supermarket): 'the shelves, floor and aisles look dim'. The global 'ceiling panels' rule hands each SupermarketLamp's point light (warm white, intensity 3, range 20) to its tube panel at gain 1: the near pixels came out 0.56 EV under the game (log2 -2.17 vs -1.61). Handover off: +1.21 EV over it (-0.40); gain 2: -1.46, 0.15 EV over the game. docs/lighting-overrides.md, 'Playtest of 2026-11-21: 8-3'.

note: Punch policy (docs/lighting-overrides.md, 'Punch on every level', 2026-11-18): the class policies of _rules.json apply.
